description: Defines the ai_interface class for AI behavior in the Battle for Wesnoth game, including nested structures, methods for game actions, and interface creation.

classes.name: ai_interface
classes.description: Abstract base class for AI implementations, providing game interaction methods and data access.

classes.name: ai_interface::info
classes.description: Holds references to game objects and state information needed by AI.

methods.name: play_turn
methods.description: Pure virtual function to implement AI turn logic.

methods.name: sync_network
methods.description: Updates networked players with AI actions.

methods.name: diagnostic
methods.description: Displays a diagnostic message on the screen.

methods.name: attack_enemy
methods.description: Commands the AI to attack an enemy unit.

methods.name: move_unit
methods.description: Moves a unit from one location to another.

methods.name: move_unit_partial
methods.description: Moves a unit without ending its movement allowance.

methods.name: calculate_possible_moves
methods.description: Calculates possible moves for units or enemies.

methods.name: recruit
methods.description: Recruits a unit at a specified or available location.

methods.name: get_info
methods.description: Returns the AI's game info object.

methods.name: user_interact
methods.description: Allows user interaction, throttled to prevent overuse.
